dock.note: Early version: pinned apps are read from dock.json, and there is no drag-to-pin yet.

look.title: Shell Looks
look.body: A desktop of our own, drawn over Windows: an overlay, and the same skin on this window and the dock. One at a time, and none is the plain Windows this app started as.
look.lookNote: The overlay and the skin are ours and change nothing on the machine. The pack that goes with a Look — accent, wallpaper, taskbar — is offered separately and goes through the usual confirmation, so you can have one without the other.
look.desc.jarvis: A heads-up display over the desktop, and the same skin on this window and the dock. The overlay is click-through: it sits above everything and blocks nothing.
jarvis.soundNote: Spoken with the voice Windows already has, and the blips are generated as they play. Nothing is downloaded, and nothing is sent anywhere.
jarvis.telemetryNote: Processor, memory, disk, network and battery, read once a second. Turning this off leaves the clock and the reactor and stops the polling.
jarvis.addressNote: Used in the greeting, spoken and shown. Leave it empty and it just says the time of day.
